scope: Two Antakya NDUI rasters, Python direct download versus user-supplied GEE exports. Not independent accuracy validation.
NaN_handling: NaN and GeoTIFF NoData are both treated as missing.
coarse_parity: Not numerically checked against the separate GEE coarse script.
private_calibration_dependency: The example was calibrated over an owner-provided Hatay province boundary. The public config defaults to the Antakya box and gives a different p99.
